institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard-of-care knowledge (NCCN/DeVita/Harrison, general reference); experimental, not clinically activated

name: Loncastuximab tesirine (anti-CD19 antibody-drug conjugate)

premedications.name: Dexamethasone
premedications.notes: 4 mg PO twice daily for 3 days starting the day before each infusion, to reduce edema/effusions

supportiveCare: Single-agent option after two or more prior lines
Monitor for fluid retention (edema, pleural/pericardial effusions) - a class effect of the PBD-dimer payload
monitoring: Dose reduced from 0.15 to 0.075 mg/kg after the first 2 cycles

drugs.name: Loncastuximab tesirine
drugs.notes: 0.15 mg/kg IV on day 1 of each 21-day cycle for the first 2 cycles, then reduce to 0.075 mg/kg for subsequent cycles.
